verdict.rationale: v0 supports pushing/syncing generated code to a GitHub repository (branches, PRs, CI) and importing existing GitHub code, which effectively gives developers full source ownership outside the platform to clone and run/host elsewhere. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm a one-click 'export as zip' or explicit guidance for running the app fully independently without Vercel-hosted deployment/backends. missing for 10: explicit export/download flow independent of GitHub, confirmation that all backend integrations (databases, env vars) are portable outside Vercel hosting.
